name: Visu
tagline: Interactive algorithm and data structure visualizer
blurb: Visu bridges the gap between pseudocode and the mental model of how algorithms and data structures behave.
description:
Visu bridges the gap between pseudocode and the mental model of how
algorithms and data structures behave. Write pseudocode in the editor,
press Run, and watch arrays, stacks, queues, deques, linked lists, sets,
maps, and directed or undirected graphs animate step by step.

Features:

• Simple pseudocode language with eight built-in structures: array, stack, queue, deque, linked list, set, map, and graph

• Step-by-step timeline with play, pause, step, and scrub controls

• Minimalist split layout with the canvas on the left and editor on the right

• Built-in pseudocode reference and example programs (bubble sort, DFS, union-find, and more)

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
